workflow_runs.name: Cookie Editor R3.3 real SDK and package verification
workflow_runs.display_title: Keep installed Cookie edits from stalling or deleting sibling scopes

head_commit.message:
Keep installed Cookie edits from stalling or deleting sibling scopes

Use the installed sandbox save action, exact expiration with approved identity checks, and valid same-package grant migration across enable transitions.

Constraint: All native acceptance mutations originate in installed Cookie Editor UI on a controlled fixture; daily development extension retained
Rejected: Native cookies.remove URL/name | Real Chrome removed sibling Paths
Rejected: Relaxing iframe allow-forms | Explicit save action preserves the existing sandbox
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: moderate
Directive: Rename is non-atomic; retain partial and unknown outcomes, and never automatically replay a mutation
Tested: UI 45/45, Cookie Driver 31/31, lifecycle 17/17; Check, isolated production/development Build and Verify; current CFT core, Path and partial rename; unchanged prior UI evidence retained
Not-tested: Full repository integration remains FAIL (2267/2292, 23 failed, 2 skipped); native Store/Partition matrix, panel widths/Zoom, race interleaving, independent F3 and ZIP remain open
